input-field.name: enquiryForm
input-field.label: CMS Page ID (Enquiry Form)
input-field.helpText: Paste the ID of the CMS page that contains the product enquiry form element. Find it in Shopping Experiences → URL of the page.

input-field.name: adminEmail
input-field.label: Admin Notification Email
input-field.helpText: Email address for admin notifications. Overrides the store default. Leave blank to use the store default email.
